source: 外研社版(新标准)选择性必修第二册 Unit 6 词表(p118 真词,跳过专有名词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、Survival 主题、含目标词;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: In London, a clever fox can find food in the bins at night.
words.example_cn: 在伦敦,聪明的狐狸夜里能在垃圾箱里找到食物。

words.example_en: Stealing food from an open car was the baboon's daily crime.
words.example_cn: 从敞开的车里偷食物是这只狒狒每天的“罪行”。

words.example_en: The theft took place in a quiet seaside suburb of the city.
words.example_cn: 偷窃发生在城市一个安静的海滨郊区。

words.example_en: The greedy thief grabbed the bag of shopping and ran away.
words.example_cn: 贪婪的小偷抓起那袋购物品就跑了。

words.example_en: The real thief turned out to be a wild baboon, not a person.
words.example_cn: 真正的“小偷”原来是一只野生狒狒,而不是人。

words.example_en: No matter how many crimes the animal would commit, no one could arrest it.
words.example_cn: 无论这只动物犯下多少“罪行”,都没人能逮捕它。

words.example_en: Foxes, lions and wild pigs are becoming common urban animals.
words.example_cn: 狐狸、狮子和野猪正成为常见的城市动物。

words.example_en: Out of reach of their natural predators, the newcomers often do well.
words.example_cn: 由于远离天敌,这些新来者往往生存得很好。

words.example_en: For its wildest newcomers, a green city can offer many benefits.
words.example_cn: 对于最野的新来者,一座绿色的城市能提供许多好处。

words.example_en: Far from danger, these animals flourish in their new city lives.
words.example_cn: 远离危险,这些动物在新的城市生活中兴旺起来。

words.example_en: Clever racoons learn how to open bins and other containers for food.
words.example_cn: 聪明的浣熊学会了打开垃圾桶和其他容器找吃的。

words.example_en: Hungry animals find plenty to eat in the garbage we throw away.
words.example_cn: 饥饿的动物能在我们丢弃的垃圾里找到很多吃的。

words.example_en: Urban foxes have even got a taste for lamb kebabs from the bins.
words.example_cn: 城市里的狐狸甚至爱上了垃圾箱里的羊肉串。

words.example_en: Some city foxes will eat anything, even leftover garlic bread.
words.example_cn: 有些城市狐狸什么都吃,连剩下的蒜香面包也吃。

words.example_en: Scientists estimate that up to a billion birds die from window crashes each year.
words.example_cn: 科学家估计每年多达十亿只鸟死于撞窗。

words.example_en: Some birds have not yet changed their old migratory routes through the city.
words.example_cn: 有些鸟还没有改变它们穿过城市的古老迁徙路线。

words.example_en: We should learn to understand and appreciate our wild neighbours.
words.example_cn: 我们应当学会理解并欣赏我们的野生邻居。

words.example_en: The ability to adapt is crucial to the survival of urban animals.
words.example_cn: 适应能力对城市动物的生存至关重要。

words.example_en: Some people argue that we should restrict building to protect wild habitats.
words.example_cn: 有人认为我们应限制建设以保护野生栖息地。

words.example_en: Whether you are a first-time hiker or an old camper, read the safety tips.
words.example_cn: 无论你是初次远足者还是老露营者,都要读读安全提示。

words.example_en: Wherever you go in the wild, always take a first-aid kit with you.
words.example_cn: 在野外无论去哪里,都要随身带上急救包。

words.example_en: A clever and optimistic person has a better chance of surviving a crisis.
words.example_cn: 一个聪明而乐观的人在危机中有更大的生存机会。

words.example_en: Robinson Crusoe made his own cups out of clay on the island.
words.example_cn: 鲁滨逊在岛上用黏土做了自己的杯子。

words.example_en: He spent days digging a cave to keep himself safe at night.
words.example_cn: 他花了好几天挖了一个洞穴,以便夜里保护自己。

words.example_en: The government has announced measures to limit the use of fuel.
words.example_cn: 政府已宣布措施来限制燃料的使用。

words.example_en: Emergency rules were made to cut the country's fuel consumption.
words.example_cn: 为削减该国的燃料消耗,出台了紧急规定。

words.example_en: Scientists are looking for new energy sources to supplement oil supplies.
words.example_cn: 科学家正在寻找新能源来补充石油供应。

words.example_en: A three-year programme aims to eliminate the rats introduced to the island.
words.example_cn: 一项三年计划旨在根除被引入岛上的老鼠。

words.example_en: After hours of hard work, the firefighters brought the blaze under control.
words.example_cn: 经过数小时的艰苦努力,消防员控制住了大火。

words.example_en: Local firefighters stopped the huge blaze from spreading any further.
words.example_cn: 当地消防员阻止了这场大火进一步蔓延。

words.example_en: They battled the fire for hours in fierce and dangerous conditions.
words.example_cn: 他们在恶劣而危险的条件下与火搏斗了数小时。

words.example_en: We talked about how people react when a sudden crisis breaks out.
words.example_cn: 我们谈到当突发危机时人们如何反应。

words.example_en: Survivor is a new monthly magazine about disaster and survival.
words.example_cn: 《幸存者》是一本关于灾难与生存的新月刊。

words.example_en: In the past, the greatest fear was that nuclear missiles could wipe out life.
words.example_cn: 过去人们最大的恐惧是核导弹会消灭一切生命。

words.example_en: Nuclear weapons could destroy humans and other advanced life forms.
words.example_cn: 核武器可能毁灭人类和其他高级生命形式。

words.example_en: A single disaster could wipe out the whole human race in a moment.
words.example_cn: 一场灾难可能在顷刻间消灭整个人类。

words.example_en: Our probes orbit Mars and send back valuable data and images.
words.example_cn: 我们的探测器环绕火星运行,传回宝贵的数据和图像。

words.example_en: Space agencies of several countries are planning manned missions to Mars.
words.example_cn: 几个国家的航天机构正在计划载人火星任务。

words.example_en: Biosphere 2 consisted of a closed space where people and plants lived together.
words.example_cn: “生物圈二号”由一个人和植物共同生活的封闭空间组成。

words.example_en: From the long journey, we can infer that reaching Mars is very risky.
words.example_cn: 从漫长的旅程我们可以推断,抵达火星非常危险。

words.example_en: Travelling to Mars would expose the crew to dangerous solar radiation.
words.example_cn: 前往火星会使机组人员暴露在危险的太阳辐射中。

words.example_en: The spacesuit protects the astronaut from exposure to the Martian surface.
words.example_cn: 宇航服保护宇航员免于暴露在火星表面。

words.example_en: The lonely astronaut was left behind after a dust storm on Mars.
words.example_cn: 一场沙尘暴后,这名孤独的宇航员被留在了火星上。

words.example_en: He lost contact with the others when he was caught in a dust storm.
words.example_cn: 他被困在一场沙尘暴中,与其他人失去了联系。

words.example_en: The landing capsule protects him from the deadly radiation outside.
words.example_cn: 着陆舱保护他免受外面致命的辐射。

words.example_en: The green lizards lived on the lower branches and trunks of the trees.
words.example_cn: 绿蜥蜴生活在树木较低的枝条和树干上。

words.example_en: During the heat wave, people were advised to stay indoors and rest.
words.example_cn: 热浪期间,人们被建议待在室内休息。

words.example_en: Mars has a less hostile environment than the other planets.
words.example_cn: 与其他行星相比,火星的环境没那么恶劣。
